pages.quiz:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does "die Küche" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. radio
   B. garden
   C. bathroom
   D. kitchen

2. If today is Mittwoch, what was yesterday (gestern)? (1 mark)
   A. Donnerstag
   B. Dienstag
   C. Freitag
   D. Montag

3. What does "der Apfel" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. apple
   B. fish
   C. banana
   D. potato

4. What does "das Haar" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. hair
   B. mouth
   C. tooth
   D. eye

5. What does "scharf" mean when we talk about a knife? (1 mark)
   A. heavy
   B. small
   C. cold
   D. sharp

6. What should you do first when reading a text for comprehension? (1 mark)
   A. Read only the last line
   B. Look at the title and pictures
   C. Copy the whole text
   D. Guess the answers

7. What does "die Tür" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. pot
   B. plate
   C. door
   D. kitchen

8. What does "Noch einmal!" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Well done!
   B. One more time!
   C. Thank you!
   D. Goodbye!

9. Which month comes right after "Januar"? (1 mark)
   A. November
   B. Mai
   C. April
   D. Februar

10. What does "Ich mag keine Cola" mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink cola every day
   B. I am buying cola
   C. I do not like cola
   D. I like cola

11. Which food group does "der Kakao" belong to? (1 mark)
   A. das Gemüse
   B. das Obst
   C. das Fleisch
   D. die Getränke

12. What is the plural of "der Zeh"? (1 mark)
   A. die Zehen
   B. die Zehner
   C. die Zehs
   D. die Zehe

13. What does "das Auge" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. eye
   B. toe
   C. mouth
   D. tooth

14. Which adjective is made from "Wolke"? (1 mark)
   A. wolkig
   B. wolken
   C. wolkin
   D. wolke

15. What does "Wo ist Oma?" ask? (1 mark)
   A. What does grandma cook?
   B. Where is grandma?
   C. How old is grandma?
   D. Who is grandma?

16. Which German word means "kind"? (describing people) (1 mark)
   A. lustig
   B. stark
   C. klein
   D. nett

17. What is the plural of "das Kind"? (1 mark)
   A. die Kinde
   B. die Kinder
   C. die Kinds
   D. die Kinden

18. Which form completes "Sie (she) ___ zwei Schwestern"? (1 mark)
   A. haben
   B. habe
   C. hast
   D. hat

19. Which German word or phrase means "garden"? (1 mark)
   A. der Tisch
   B. das Zimmer
   C. der Garten
   D. der Schrank

20. Which German word or phrase means "clock"? (1 mark)
   A. die Uhr
   B. der Stuhl
   C. das Sofa
   D. der Topf

21. How is a Rückendiktat done? (1 mark)
   A. A partner writes letters on your back and you write the word
   B. You write on the board
   C. You read aloud
   D. You copy from a book

22. Which German word means "to read"? (verb) (1 mark)
   A. trinken
   B. hören
   C. lesen
   D. tanzen

23. How do you say "on the fifth of May"? (1 mark)
   A. am fünf Mai
   B. an fünften Mai
   C. am fünften Mai
   D. am fünfe Mai

24. What does "Februar" mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. February
   B. March
   C. October
   D. August

25. Which German word means "July"? (month) (1 mark)
   A. April
   B. Mai
   C. Juni
   D. Juli

26. Which German word or phrase means "milk"? (1 mark)
   A. die Kartoffel
   B. der Apfel
   C. der Saft
   D. die Milch

27. Which word in the menu joins two foods? (1 mark)
   A. aber
   B. nicht
   C. oder
   D. und

28. Which plural has an umlaut? (1 mark)
   A. die Füße
   B. die Augen
   C. die Ohren
   D. die Beine

29. Which German word means "dry"? (weather) (1 mark)
   A. warm
   B. heiß
   C. trocken
   D. wolkig

30. What does "Gestern war es windig" mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow it will be windy
   B. Today it is windy
   C. Yesterday it was windy
   D. It is always windy

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Explain the difference between "Es regnet" and "Es ist regnerisch". (2 marks)

32. Make a playful food blend from Mango and Milch, and say what it is. (2 marks)

33. Write the German words with their articles for: rice, milk, egg, banana. (4 marks)

34. Write the German names of these months: October, November, December. (3 marks)

35. Write a sentence about your favourite room in German. (2 marks)

36. Write three words from a Kenyan greeting or from German that must begin with a capital letter, and say why. (3 marks)

37. Write three sentences that say which item is in which room. (3 marks)

38. Write the German words with der, die or das for: son, mouth, door, radio, nose. (5 marks)

39. Write the German names of these months: January, February, March. (3 marks)

40. Write three sentences about your body in German. (3 marks)

41. Write four short German sentences that a child could say about his or her birthday. (4 marks)

42. Write three sentences in German that say where things are in your room. (3 marks)

43. Write the German words with der, die or das for: tummy, apple, cheese. (3 marks)

44. Write the German words with der, die or das for: onion, parents, ear, cloud, cake. (5 marks)

45. Give two reasons why imitating a teacher or a recording helps when learning German sounds. (2 marks)

46. Write the German names of these months: April, May, June. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
GERMAN — MOCK EXAM #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — kitchen
   die Küche means kitchen.

2. B — Dienstag
   The day before Mittwoch is Dienstag.

3. A — apple
   der Apfel means apple.

4. A — hair
   das Haar means hair.

5. D — sharp
   scharf means sharp.

6. B — Look at the title and pictures
   The title and pictures give clues about the topic.

7. C — door
   die Tür means door.

8. B — One more time!
   Noch einmal means once more.

9. D — Februar
   After Januar comes Februar.

10. C — I do not like cola
   keine shows that the person does not like cola.

11. D — die Getränke
   der Kakao belongs to die Getränke.

12. A — die Zehen
   The plural of der Zeh is die Zehen.

13. A — eye
   das Auge means eye.

14. A — wolkig
   Wolke + -ig gives wolkig, cloudy.

15. B — Where is grandma?
   wo means where.

16. D — nett
   kind in German is nett.

17. B — die Kinder
   The plural of das Kind is die Kinder.

18. D — hat
   sie (she) goes with hat.

19. C — der Garten
   garden in German is der Garten.

20. A — die Uhr
   clock in German is die Uhr.

21. A — A partner writes letters on your back and you write the word
   Rücken means back.

22. C — lesen
   to read in German is lesen.

23. C — am fünften Mai
   am fünften Mai is correct.

24. A — February
   Februar means February.

25. D — Juli
   July in German is Juli.

26. D — die Milch
   milk in German is die Milch.

27. D — und
   und means and.

28. A — die Füße
   Fuß becomes Füße.

29. C — trocken
   dry in German is trocken.

30. C — Yesterday it was windy
   gestern = yesterday and war = was.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Es regnet uses a verb and means it is raining. Es ist regnerisch uses an adjective and means it is rainy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mangmil, a mango and milk drink.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a sensible blend, 1 mark for the explanation.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: der Reis, die Milch, das Ei, die Banane.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with its article.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Oktober, November, Dezember.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: Mein Lieblingszimmer ist die Küche.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the sentence and 1 mark for correct spelling.

36. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Guten Morgen, Amina, Kenia. Nouns, names and the first word of a sentence begin with capitals.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for examples, 1 mark for nouns, 1 mark for names.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist im Schlafzimmer. Der Tisch ist in der Küche. Das Sofa ist im Wohnzimmer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

38. (5 marks)
   Answer: der Sohn, der Mund, die Tür, das Radio, die Nase.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: Januar, Februar, März.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich habe zwei Augen. Das ist meine Nase. Mit den Ohren höre ich.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

41. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: Ich bin heute zehn. Ich habe einen Kuchen. Meine Familie ist da. Alles Gute zum Geburtstag!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Das Bett ist an der Wand. Der Tisch ist neben dem Bett. Die Tasche ist unter dem Tisch.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: der Bauch, der Apfel, der Käse.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (3 marks).

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: die Zwiebel, die Eltern, das Ohr, die Wolke, der Kuchen.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct noun with the correct article (5 marks).

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: We hear the right sounds and practise them again and again, so our mouth learns them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: April, Mai, Juni.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correctly spelled month with a capital letter.
